package.name: aav_hud
package.description: hud: the in-car screen in Rust, one raylib program that is also its ROS node (rclrs). Speed, mode, the e-stop button, steering, throttle and brake, the GPS fix, topic health, the stop-sign alert and the camera. Topic names in config/hud.yaml. Also map: the big screen's map window (Nav2's map, the car, the plan, the distance left), topic names in config/map.yaml. And debug_hud: the debug screen (the lidar's cubes in 3D, where each localizer puts the car, every sensor from its own topic), topic names in config/debug_hud.yaml. And hw_panel: the hardware screen (every sensor's number, simple buttons for the actuators through twist_mux's buttons slot), topic names in config/hw_panel.yaml.
